description: One topic of 6 partitions fed at 2 records/s per partition, and a group of 3 consumers, each owning the partitions the coordinator targets for it.

wait.jq: [.groups[] | select(.id == "orders-app") | .consumers[]] as $c | ($c | length) == 3 and all($c[]; (.raw.assignment | length) > 0 and (.raw.assignment | sort) == (.raw.targetAssignment | sort)) and ([$c[].raw.assignment[]] | length) == 6
